column2: The empire reached its zenith under a ruler who expanded trade and the arts.
column3: 這個帝國在一位推廣貿易與藝術的統治者手中達到全盛。
column4: reach the zenith (達到頂點)
column5: zenith 是天頂：太陽正在頭頂的最高點

column2: Winning the Nobel Prize marked the pinnacle of her scientific career.
column3: 獲得諾貝爾獎是她科學生涯的巔峰。
column4: the pinnacle of success (成功的頂峰)
column5: pin 是針，針尖般尖尖的塔頂就是 pinnacle

column2: The triangle's apex pointed toward the north, where the road met the river.
column3: 三角形的頂點朝向北方，也就是道路與河流交會之處。
column4: the apex of a triangle (三角形的頂點)
column5: apex 的 A 像 A 字形的尖尖頂端

column2: For many fans, that album marked the acme of the band's creativity.
column3: 對許多樂迷來說，那張專輯是樂團創意的巔峰。
column4: the acme of perfection (完美的極致)
column5: acme 唸「愛可迷」：粉絲愛到入迷的最高點

column2: The hikers reached the summit just as the sun rose over the clouds.
column3: 登山客抵達山頂時，太陽剛好從雲海上升起。
column4: reach the summit (登上山頂)
column5: summit 唸「三米」：爬到最後三米就是山頂

column2: Morale hit its nadir after the team lost ten games in a row.
column3: 球隊連輸十場後，士氣跌到最低點。
column4: reach the nadir (跌到最低點)
column5: 和 zenith 相反：腳底下正對著的最深處
column8: 最低點；谷底；最不幸；深淵

column2: Sales hit a trough in February before climbing again with the spring season.
column3: 二月銷售跌到低谷，隨著春季到來才再度回升。
column4: a trough in sales (銷售低谷)
column5: trough 是 U 形的餵食槽，低低凹下去，像波谷

column2: The scandal was the catalyst that finally pushed voters to demand reform.
column3: 那件醜聞成為促使選民終於要求改革的導火線。
column4: a catalyst for change (促成改變的催化劑)
column5: cat 貓跳進房間，一場騷動就被引發了
column8: 催化劑；促成改變之人事物

column2: Poor eyesight proved no impediment to her becoming a skilled pianist.
column3: 視力不佳並沒有妨礙她成為技巧純熟的鋼琴家。
column4: an impediment to progress (進步的阻礙)
column5: im 在內 + ped 腳 → 腳被絆住了走不動

column2: A fallen tree was the last obstacle between the runners and the finish line.
column3: 一棵倒下的樹是跑者與終點線之間的最後一道障礙。
column4: overcome an obstacle (克服障礙)
column5: ob 擋在前面 + sta 站 → 站在路中間擋路的東西

column2: Heavy luggage is a hindrance when you need to board a train quickly.
column3: 需要快速上火車時，沉重的行李是一種阻礙。
column4: a hindrance to growth (成長的阻礙)
column5: hind 是後面：有東西在後面拉著你

column2: Debt became an encumbrance, limiting what the family could buy or invest in.
column3: 債務成為累贅，限制了這個家庭能買的東西與投資的標的。
column4: an encumbrance on property (產權上的負擔)
column5: 諧音「因砍不完」：負擔怎麼砍都砍不完

column2: The nascent industry needed government support to survive its first few years.
column3: 這個新興產業需要政府支持，才能撐過最初幾年。
column4: a nascent industry (新興產業)
column5: nasc 是出生，和 natal 同源：剛剛出生的

column2: Her inchoate ideas about the novel had not yet formed a coherent plot.
column3: 她對小說的初步想法尚未成形，還拼不出連貫的情節。
column4: inchoate ideas (尚未成形的想法)
column5: 像一碗還沒攪好的巧克力麵糊，輪廓都還沒出來
column8: 初期的；未成熟；未定型的

column2: Doctors caught the incipient infection early and treated it before it spread.
column3: 醫師及早發現剛出現的感染，在擴散前就加以治療。
column4: incipient stage (初期階段)
column5: in 進入 + cip 拿起 → 剛剛要開始動手

column2: The burgeoning city attracted thousands of new workers each year.
column3: 這座迅速成長的城市每年吸引數千名新工人。
column4: a burgeoning economy (迅速成長的經濟)
column5: 想像春天嫩芽 bur-bur 一直冒出來，欣欣向榮

column2: A flourishing market filled the square with fruit, fabrics, and cheerful bargaining.
column3: 興旺的市集讓廣場擠滿水果、布料與愉快的討價還價。
column4: a flourishing business (興旺的生意)
column5: flour 和 flower 同源，花開得滿滿的就是繁榮

column2: The moribund steel mill employed fewer workers each year before it finally closed.
column3: 那間奄奄一息的鋼鐵廠每年雇用的工人越來越少，最後終於關閉。
column4: a moribund industry (垂死的產業)
column5: mor 與 mort 同源，像快沒電的手機，只剩一格
column8: 垂死；停滯不前；奄奄一息的

column2: Stagnant water in the pond turned green and began to smell.
column3: 池塘裡不流動的水變綠了，還開始發出臭味。
column4: stagnant water (死水)
column5: stag 像 stay：水停在原地不動，就變成死水
column8: 停滯；不流動；死水；沉悶的

column2: The volcano has been dormant for centuries, though scientists still monitor it.
column3: 這座火山已休眠數百年，不過科學家仍持續監測。
column4: a dormant volcano (休眠火山)
column5: dorm 宿舍是睡覺的地方，dormant 就是在睡覺

column2: The quiescent village stirred only at dawn, when the bakers lit their ovens.
column3: 寧靜的村莊只有在黎明麵包師傅點燃烤爐時才有動靜。
column4: remain quiescent (保持沉寂)
column5: qui 像 quiet 安靜：靜悄悄的狀態

column2: She discovered a latent talent for drawing while helping her niece with homework.
column3: 她在幫姪女寫作業時，發現自己藏有繪畫的潛在天分。
column4: a latent talent (潛藏的天分)
column5: late 晚：天分躲著，晚一點才冒出來

column2: Darwin's theory changed the paradigm through which biologists understood life.
column3: 達爾文的理論改變了生物學家理解生命的思考架構。
column4: a paradigm shift (典範轉移)
column5: para 旁邊 + digm 展示 → 放在旁邊讓大家照著做的樣板

column2: Engineers tested the prototype for months before the car went into production.
column3: 工程師測試原型車好幾個月，之後這款車才進入量產。
column4: build a prototype (打造原型)
column5: proto 第一 + type 型 → 第一個做出來的型號

column2: She was an exemplar of patience, calmly teaching the same lesson twenty times.
column3: 她是耐心的典範，冷靜地把同一堂課教了二十遍。
column4: an exemplar of virtue (美德的典範)
column5: ex 出來 + sample 樣本 → 被挑出來當樣本的人

column2: Sherlock Holmes became the archetype of the brilliant, eccentric detective.
column3: 福爾摩斯成為聰明又古怪的偵探之原型。
column4: the archetype of a hero (英雄的原型)
column5: arch 首要 + type 型 → 所有同類角色的第一型

column2: Silence is the antithesis of the noisy, crowded market where she grew up.
column3: 寂靜正好與她成長的那個嘈雜擁擠的市場相反。
column4: the antithesis of love (與愛相反的事物)
column5: anti 相反 + thesis 論點 → 針鋒相對的另一邊

column2: The prime minister will meet her French counterpart to discuss trade rules.
column3: 首相將與法國的對等官員會面，討論貿易規則。
column4: a diplomatic counterpart (外交上的對等人員)
column5: counter 對面 + part 角色 → 坐在對面的同等角色
column8: 對等人員；職位對應事物

column2: The telegraph was a precursor of the telephone and the internet.
column3: 電報是電話與網際網路的前身。
column4: a precursor to the disease (疾病的前兆)
column5: pre 先 + cur 跑 → 跑在前面開路的

column2: The first robin of the year is a harbinger of spring.
column3: 一年中第一隻知更鳥是春天的預兆。
column4: a harbinger of spring (春天的預兆)
column5: 古時 harbinger 是先到前面為王室安排住宿的人，來通報主人快到了

column2: Young designers stood in the vanguard of the movement toward recycled fabrics.
column3: 年輕設計師站在這場使用再生布料運動的最前線。
column4: in the vanguard (走在最前線)
column5: van 是前方 + guard 守衛 → 走在隊伍最前面

column2: The diaries were preserved for posterity so future historians could study daily life.
column3: 這些日記被保存下來留給後代，讓未來的歷史學家研究日常生活。
column4: for the sake of posterity (為了後世子孫)
column5: post 後面 → 排在你後面的一代代人

column2: The queen's progeny ruled the kingdom for three centuries.
column3: 女王的子嗣統治這個王國長達三個世紀。
column4: the progeny of kings (國王的後裔)
column5: pro 向前 + gen 生 → 往前生出來的下一代

column2: Her lineage can be traced back to a family of merchants in medieval Venice.
column3: 她的家系可追溯到中世紀威尼斯的一個商人家族。
column4: trace one's lineage (追溯家系)
column5: line 線：家族一代接一代連成的一條線

column2: Her business acumen helped the small shop survive when larger rivals failed.
column3: 她的商業眼光讓小店在大型對手倒閉時仍能存活。
column4: business acumen (商業敏銳度)
column5: ac 尖，和 acute 同源：頭腦像針尖一樣銳利

column2: The detective's perspicacity allowed her to notice the one detail everyone else missed.
column3: 偵探的明察秋毫，讓她注意到其他人都漏掉的那個細節。
column4: admire her perspicacity (欽佩她的洞察力)
column5: per 透過 + spic 看 → 一眼看穿事情

column2: The elder's sagacity won respect; villagers sought her advice before any major decision.
column3: 這位長者的睿智贏得敬重，村民在做重大決定前都會向她請益。
column4: sagacity and wisdom (睿智與智慧)
column5: sage 是智者，sagacity 就是智者擁有的特質

column2: Good discernment is needed to separate reliable sources from persuasive rumors online.
column3: 要從網路上具說服力的謠言中分辨出可靠來源，需要良好的辨識力。
column4: show good discernment (展現良好眼光)
column5: dis 分開 + cern 篩 → 把好壞篩開的能力

column2: His shrewdness in negotiations meant he rarely paid more than a fair price.
column3: 他在談判中的精明，讓他很少付出超過合理的價格。
column4: political shrewdness (政治上的精明)
column5: shrew 是小尖鼻的鼩鼱，機靈又警覺

column2: The astuteness of her investment choices surprised older, more experienced analysts.
column3: 她投資選擇的精明，讓年長又更有經驗的分析師大為驚訝。
column4: astuteness in business (商業上的機智)
column5: 像 acute 的雙胞胎，頭腦尖尖的很敏捷
